title: Handling of failure to resume RRC Connection

entities.name: RRC Connection Resume Failure Handling
entities.description: Procedure executed by UE when RRC connection resume fails, involving cleanup of failure reports and transition to RRC_IDLE state.

entities.name: VarConnEstFailReport
entities.description: UE variable storing connection establishment and resume failure information including PLMN identity, cell measurements, and failure count.

entities.name: VarConnEstFailReportList
entities.description: UE variable storing multiple connection failure reports when multiple CEF report is supported.

entities.name: numberOfConnFail
entities.description: Counter tracking the number of connection failures, incremented up to a maximum of 8.

entities.name: T319
entities.description: Timer running during RRC connection resume procedure.

entities.name: T319a
entities.description: Timer running during RRC connection resume procedure.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state entered upon connection resume failure.

entities.name: PLMN change condition
entities.description: Condition where RPLMN is not equal to plmn-identity stored in failure report.

entities.name: Cell change condition
entities.description: Condition where current cell identity differs from failed cell identity in failure report.

entities.name: Integrity check failure condition
entities.description: Condition where integrity check failure indication is received from lower layers while T319 or T319a is running.

entities.name: RLC maximum retransmissions condition
entities.description: Condition where MCG RLC indicates maximum number of retransmissions reached while T319a is running.

entities.name: Random access problem condition
entities.description: Condition where random access problem indication is received from MCG MAC while T319a is running.

entities.name: CG-SDT timer expiry condition
entities.description: Condition where cg-SDT-TimeAlignmentTimer expires before receiving network response for UL CG-SDT transmission while T319a is running.

relations.description: Procedure execution is conditioned by PLMN change detection.
Procedure execution is conditioned by cell change detection.
Procedure resets numberOfConnFail to 0 under certain conditions.
Procedure clears content in VarConnEstFailReportList under PLMN change condition.
Procedure stores connection resume failure information in VarConnEstFailReport.
Procedure increments numberOfConnFail by 1 if it is smaller than 8.
Procedure transitions UE to RRC_IDLE state with release cause 'RRC Resume failure'.
Integrity check failure condition triggers transition to RRC_IDLE state.
RLC maximum retransmissions condition triggers transition to RRC_IDLE state.
Random access problem condition triggers transition to RRC_IDLE state.
CG-SDT timer expiry condition triggers transition to RRC_IDLE state.
Integrity check failure condition requires T319 timer to be running.
Integrity check failure condition requires T319a timer to be running.
